Three things to know before you build:

RecordSittingClosed() finally has a caller. It has been dead code since M1 — nothing in the system could close a sitting. SittingClosed likewise: TableOrderSurface and KitchenBoard both already subscribe to it, so the guest flip to a settled bill and the kitchen dropping the table should both start working the moment you first press Close.

IOrderWorkflow gained a method, IOrderMutations did not — so the existing FakeOrderMutations in OrderWorkflowTests still compiles untouched.

Likely break sites, in order: CounterSitting.razor (longest new component; inline editors keyed off a line id inside a nested @foreach, two <select>s bound to string and parsed with Guid.TryParse rather than trusting BindConverter for Guid). Then CounterBoardReads.cs, whose LATERAL casts fail at run time in a Testcontainers test rather than at compile time — count(*) is bigint and sum() over it widens to numeric, and Dapper's constructor binding will feed neither into an int.

I ran brace-balance and markup tag-balance checks over all the new files; both clean. That's not a compiler, so send me whatever dotnet build says.
